title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) Microsoft 365, Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
description:
Über Kigen IT-Systemhaus
Kigen IT-Systemhaus ist ein auf Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit spezialisiertes Unternehmen mit Standorten in Engstingen und Stuttgart. Wir betreuen Unternehmen von der Kanzlei bis zur Unternehmensgruppe und legen Wert auf saubere, sichere IT-Umgebungen. Bei uns gibt es kurze Wege, Vertrauen und echte Weiterentwicklung statt Konzernstrukturen.
 Deine Aufgaben
Du bist fester technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Raum Stuttgart. Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen im First und Second Level, richtest Arbeitsplätze, Drucker und Besprechungsräume ein und bist bei Bedarf auch vor Ort beim Kunden. Im laufenden Betrieb verwaltest du Benutzer, Geräte und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online und Teams und unterstützt in hybriden Umgebungen mit Active Directory.
 Das bringst du mit
Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung und bereits im IT-Support oder in der Administration gearbeitet. Windows Clients und Active Directory sind dir vertraut, Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 und Intune ist ein Plus. Du hast einen Führerschein und gehst ruhig und freundlich mit Kunden um. Du erfüllst nicht alles? Wenn du motiviert bist, dich einzuarbeiten, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.
 Deine ersten Monate
Du lernst unsere Kunden und deren Umgebungen kennen, übernimmst Schritt für Schritt den Support und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Gründer zusammen. So bekommst du direkten Wissenstransfer, auch in Themen wie Security und Compliance.
 Was wir bieten
 Teilzeit (ab 20 Stunden) oder Vollzeit, ganz wie es zu dir passt
 Remote-Arbeit, vor Ort nur bei Kundenterminen im Raum Stuttgart
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und moderne Ausstattung
 Echte Lernkurve in Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit
 Vergütung
45.000 bis 55.000 € brutto jährlich bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung. Bei Teilzeit anteilig.

title: Brand Strategy Lead, Brand Architecture & Naming
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 As a Brand Strategy Lead at Anthropic, you will own brand architecture and naming strategy across the Anthropic and Claude brands. Claude is becoming part of how people work, build, and discover, and how we organize and name what we make shapes how a broad, global audience of enterprise buyers, developers, researchers, policymakers, and the general public understands it and whether they trust it. This is a foundational role: you'll solidify this function at Anthropic, making the routine calls yourself and bringing the biggest decisions to senior leaders with a clear recommendation.
 In this role, you'll own all brand architecture and naming strategy work globally, from how the portfolio fits together as it grows to the names we ship, and you'll build the systems, structure, and processes other teams follow. In a single week, you might map part of the portfolio, generate names, and take multiple recommendations to senior leaders. This is a senior individual contributor role, so you'll scope the work yourself and set a roadmap a year out with minimal direction. You'll partner closely with Brand Design, Product and Brand Marketing, Product teams, IP Legal, and Comms to position new offerings and introduce them to the world.
 Key responsibilities
 Own all brand architecture strategy across Anthropic and Claude, including how brands, products, models, features, plans, and programs relate to one another

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
description:
Who we are
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
 Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
 About the role:
 You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.
You should apply if:
 You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
